title: Try Catch Block
explanation: try/catch blocks handle runtime exceptions gracefully.

title: Throw Custom Exception
explanation: throw raises an exception that can be caught by a catch block.

title: Custom Exception Class
explanation: Derive custom exceptions from std::exception and override what().

title: Catch Different Exception Types
explanation: Catch more specific exceptions before general ones.

title: Catch All Exceptions
explanation: ... catches any exception, including non-standard ones.

title: Noexcept Specifier
description: Mark a function as non-throwing with noexcept
explanation: noexcept enables compiler optimizations and is essential for move semantics.

title: Try Catch With Rethrow
description: Catch and rethrow an exception with additional info
explanation: Nested exceptions preserve the full call chain.

title: Function Try Block
description: Wrap entire function body in try/catch
explanation: Function try blocks can catch exceptions from member initializer lists.

title: Std Exception Hierarchy
explanation: Standard exceptions form a hierarchy rooted at std::exception.
